items.headline: Tuberculosis deaths down 35 percent since 2015, WHO reports
items.summary: WHO's annual report finds TB deaths fell to 1.1 million in 2025, reaching the first End TB mortality milestone, and treatment has saved an estimated 86 million lives since 2000.
items.why_it_matters: Tuberculosis is the world's deadliest infectious disease.

items.headline: Euclid telescope releases a map of 900 million galaxies
items.summary: The European Space Agency released Euclid's first major dataset, covering about 14 percent of its planned survey of the sky.
items.why_it_matters: The open data will help scientists probe dark matter and dark energy, which make up most of the universe.
